repos_data.description: CCXT for prediction markets. PMXT is a unified API for trading on Polymarket, Kalshi, and more.

Oracle3: open-source trading engine and MCP server for prediction markets. Finds fee-adjusted no-arbitrage violations across related event contracts and trades them live on Kalshi, Polymarket and Solana, or on paper, under pre-trade risk limits. 13 MCP tools, JSON CLI, agent skills, 600+ tests.
Polymarket high-frequency trading and market-making backtesting, written in Rust.
A Polymarket sports market-making / arbitrage bot in Python - de-vig sportsbook odds, quote, hedge. The retired code behind a public $5k wallet.
🐋 Real-time whale trade tracker for Polymarket — get terminal alerts + Telegram notifications when smart money moves
Python SDK for Polymarket order book data and backtesting. Tick-level L2 snapshots, billions of deltas, full book reconstruction, and a strategy backtesting engine with realistic execution.
A self-improving weather forecasting & trading agent, in public.

The most comprehensive MCP server for Polymarket — 48 tools spanning direct trading, market discovery, smart money tracking, copy trading, backtesting, risk management, and portfolio optimization. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible client.
MCP server for crypto portfolio tracking. No dashboard UI — AI hosts render on demand. Bybit, Binance, MetaMask, Solana, Polymarket.
MCP server for Verilex Data — query NPI, SEC, PACER, Weather, and OTC datasets from AI agents

Python MCP server for ParlayAPI sports odds and props. Public discovery needs no key; account data uses your own key. Includes signup, login-email, checkout-link and preference actions. MIT code; API data redistribution rights are not included.
Quantitative Risk & Slippage Guard for AI Agents: Polymarket L2 VWAP, On-chain DEX & Cross-Venue Arbitrage (x402 Remote MCP)
Lab of 11 candidate Polymarket trading bots + research framework. Honest results, real data. Companion dataset: polymarket-canary-tape.
TypeScript/JavaScript SDK and the ot CLI for outcometick — write a strategy, check it locally, and run it against real archived prediction-market data in a sandbox.
MCP server for the Predge Whale Data x402 API — Polymarket whale trades & smart-money signals as agent tools, paid per call in USDC on Base. Bring a funded wallet key.
MCP server that matches news headlines to the Polymarket prediction markets they could move — live odds, deep links, explainable matching

Hosted MCP server for Kalshi & Polymarket. Free, no key: NFL prop board, Kalshi vs Polymarket gaps, Kalshi weather board, 15-min crypto & metals, perps, Fed odds, Senate map, NHL, NBA, EV/Kelly. 44 tools, 37 free. Docs: predictionmarketspicks.com/mcp
